'''Country Club''' is a residential [[neighborhood]] located in the [[East Bronx]] in [[New York City]]. The neighborhood's boundaries are Middletown Road and Watt Avenue to the north, [[Eastchester Bay]] to the east, Layton Avenue and the [[Throggs Neck]] neighborhood to the south, and the [[New England Thruway]] and [[Pelham Bay (neighborhood), Bronx|Pelham Bay]] neighborhood to the west.<ref name=":0">{{Cite news|url=https://www.nytimes.com/2010/04/04/realestate/04living.html|title=Country Club, the Bronx: Passed Down to Generations|last=Vandam|first=Jeff|date=2010-04-02|newspaper=The New York Times|access-date=2017-01-08|issn=0362-4331}}</ref> [[Pelham Bay Park]] (including [[Orchard Beach, Bronx|Orchard Beach]]), the largest public park in [[New York City]], is located just north of Country Club.

The neighborhood is part of [[Bronx Community Board 10]], and its ZIP Code is 10465. The area is policed by the 45th Precinct of the [[New York City Police Department]].<ref>[http://www.nyc.gov/html/nypd/html/precincts/precinct_045.shtml 45th Precinct Official Website]</ref> Country Club contains a large [[Italian-American]] population.<ref name=":0" />

==Demographics==
{{As of|2018}} Country Club has a population of around 7,500 people. It is a predominantly white neighborhood with around 73.0% of the population being non-Hispanic white, while approximately 22.3% are Hispanic or Latino, 3.5% are Asian, and the remaining are black, two or more races, or another race.<ref>{{cite web |title=Demographics |url=https://statisticalatlas.com/neighborhood/New-York/New-York/Country-Club/Race-and-Ethnicity}}</ref> Country Club also has a sizable Italian-American community with many family owned Italian specialty stores and delicatessens.<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.nytimes.com/2003/01/12/realestate/if-you-re-thinking-living-country-club-bronx-waterfront-enclave-within-city.html|title=If You're Thinking of Living In/Country Club, the Bronx; A Waterfront Enclave Within the City|last=Wilson|first=Claire|date=2003-01-12|work=The New York Times|access-date=2019-07-13|language=en-US|issn=0362-4331}}</ref>

The entirety of Community District 10, which comprises Country Club, City Island, Co-op City, Pelham Bay, Schuylerville,
Throgs Neck, and Westchester Square, had 121,868 inhabitants as of [[New York City Department of Health and Mental Hygiene|NYC Health]]'s 2018 Community Health Profile, with an average life expectancy of 81.1 years.<ref name="CHP2018">{{Cite web|url=https://www1.nyc.gov/assets/doh/downloads/pdf/data/2018chp-bx10.pdf|title=Throgs Neck and Co-op City (Including City Island, Co-op City, Country Club, Pelham Bay, Schuylerville, Throgs Neck and Westchester Square)|date=2018|website=nyc.gov|publisher=NYC Health|access-date=March 2, 2019}}</ref>{{Rp|2, 20}} This is about the same as the median life expectancy of 81.2 for all New York City neighborhoods.<ref name=":21">{{Cite web|url=https://www1.nyc.gov/assets/doh/downloads/pdf/tcny/community-health-assessment-plan.pdf|title=2016-2018 Community Health Assessment and Community Health Improvement Plan: Take Care New York 2020|date=2016|website=[[government of New York City|nyc.gov]]|publisher=[[New York City Department of Health and Mental Hygiene]]|access-date=September 8, 2017}}</ref>{{Rp|53 (PDF p. 84)}}<ref>{{cite web | title=New Yorkers are living longer, happier and healthier lives | website=New York Post | last=Short | first=Aaron | date=June 4, 2017 | url=https://nypost.com/2017/06/04/new-yorkers-are-living-longer-happier-and-healthier-lives/ | access-date=March 1, 2019}}</ref> Most inhabitants are youth and middle-aged adults: 20% are between the ages of between 0–17, 26% between 25 and 44, and 27% between 45 and 64. The proportion of college-aged and elderly residents was lower, at 9% and 18% respectively.<ref name="CHP2018" />{{Rp|2}}

==Health==
{{As of|2018}}, [[preterm birth]]s are more common in Community District 10, which comprises Country Club, City Island, Co-op City, Pelham Bay, Schuylerville, Throgs Neck, and Westchester Square, than in other places citywide, though births to teenage mothers are less common. In Community District 10, there were 110 preterm births per 1,000 live births (compared to 87 per 1,000 citywide), and 10.3 births to teenage mothers per 1,000 live births (compared to 19.3 per 1,000 citywide).<ref name="CHP2018" />{{Rp|11}} Community District 10 has a low population of residents who are [[Health insurance coverage in the United States|uninsured]]. In 2018, this population of uninsured residents was estimated to be 7%, lower than the citywide rate of 14%, though this was based on a small sample size.<ref name="CHP2018" />{{Rp|14}}

The concentration of [[particulates|fine particulate matter]], the deadliest type of [[air pollution|air pollutant]], in Community District 10 is {{convert|0.0075|mg/m3|oz/ft3}}, the same as the city average.<ref name="CHP2018" />{{Rp|9}} Fourteen percent of Community District 10 residents are [[Smoking|smokers]], which is the same as the city average of 14% of residents being smokers.<ref name="CHP2018" />{{Rp|13}} In Community District 10, 24% of residents are [[Obesity|obese]], 13% are [[Diabetes mellitus|diabetic]], and 37% have [[hypertension|high blood pressure]]—compared to the citywide averages of 24%, 11%, and 28% respectively.<ref name="CHP2018" />{{Rp|16}} In addition, 25% of children are obese, compared to the citywide average of 20%.<ref name="CHP2018" />{{Rp|12}}

Eighty-seven percent of residents eat some fruits and vegetables every day, which is the same as the city's average of 87%. In 2018, 77% of residents described their health as "good", "very good", or "excellent", about the same as the city's average of 78%.<ref name="CHP2018" />{{Rp|13}} For every supermarket in Community District 10, there are 7 [[convenience store|bodegas]].<ref name="CHP2018" />{{Rp|10}}

[[File:Country Club Neighborhood Sign at the intersection Fairmount Ave and Dean Ave.jpg|thumb|left|Country Club Neighborhood Sign at the intersection Fairmount Ave and Dean Ave]]

==Post Office and ZIP Code==
Country Club is located within [[ZIP Code]] 10465.<ref>{{cite web|title=Zip Code 10465, Bronx, New York|url=https://www.zipmap.net/zips/10465.htm|access-date=March 16, 2020|website=zipmap.net|archive-date=December 28, 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191228150055/http://www.zipmap.net/zips/10465.htm|url-status=dead}}</ref> The closest post offices are the Throggs Neck Post Office at 3630 East Tremont Avenue and the Pilgrim Post Office at 1545 Crosby Avenue, both operated by the [[United States Postal Service]].<ref>{{cite web | title=USPS PO Locator | website=USPS.com | url=https://tools.usps.com/find-location.htm?locationType=po&address=10465&searchRadius=20&fdbid=1358095& | access-date=March 16, 2020}}</ref>

==Education==
Country Club has a private primary educational institution within its borders, Villa Maria Academy, operated by the [[Congregation of Notre Dame of Montreal]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Villa Maria Academy Official Website|url=http://www.vma-ny.org/|access-date=17 October 2015}}</ref> The two zoned public elementary schools are [https://www.schools.nyc.gov/schools/X071 PS 71] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200812013249/https://www.schools.nyc.gov/schools/X071 |date=2020-08-12 }} (zoned for residents above Waterbury Avenue), and [https://www.schools.nyc.gov/schools/X014 PS 14] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201025104759/https://www.schools.nyc.gov/schools/X014 |date=2020-10-25 }} (zoned for residents below Waterbury Avenue), both in nearby Pelham Bay in the [[New York City Department of Education]]'s District 8.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://schoolzones.us/nyc/schools/ps-x014-senator-john-calandra/|title=NYC School Zones|website=schoolzones.us|access-date=2020-03-15}}</ref> The zoned middle school is the [https://www.schools.nyc.gov/schools/X371 Urban Institute of Mathematics] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200805203100/https://www.schools.nyc.gov/schools/X371 |date=2020-08-05 }}.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://data.cityofnewyork.us/Education/2017-2018-School-Zones/ghq4-ydq4|title=2017-2018 School Zones|website=data.cityofnewyork.us|access-date=2020-03-15}}</ref>

==Police and crime==
Country Club is patrolled by the 45th Precinct of the [[New York City Police Department|NYPD]], located at 2877 Barkley Avenue in Throggs Neck.<ref name="NYPD 45th Precinct">{{Cite web|url=https://www1.nyc.gov/site/nypd/bureaus/patrol/precincts/45th-precinct.page|title=NYPD – 45th Precinct|website=www.nyc.gov|publisher=[[New York City Police Department]]|access-date=October 3, 2016}}</ref> The 45th Precinct ranked 28th safest out of 69 patrol areas for per-capita crime in 2010.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.dnainfo.com/new-york/crime-safety-report/bronx/throgs-neck/|title=Throgs Neck: City Island, Pelham Bay, Co-op City – DNAinfo.com Crime and Safety Report|website=www.dnainfo.com|access-date=October 6, 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170415064635/https://www.dnainfo.com/new-york/crime-safety-report/bronx/throgs-neck|archive-date=April 15, 2017|url-status=dead}}</ref> {{As of|2018}}, with a non-fatal assault rate of 53 per 100,000 people, the 45th Precinct's rate of [[violent crime]]s per capita is less than that of the city as a whole. The Community District 10 incarceration rate of 243 per 100,000 people is lower than that of the city as a whole.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www1.nyc.gov/assets/doh/downloads/pdf/data/2018chp-bx10.pdf|title=Throgs Neck and Co-op City (Including City Island, Co-op City, Country Club, Pelham Bay, Schuylerville, Throgs Neck and Westchester Square)|date=2018|website=nyc.gov|publisher=NYC Health|access-date=March 2, 2019}}</ref>

The 45th Precinct has a lower crime rate than in the 1990s, with crimes across all categories having decreased by 67% between 1990 and 2022. The precinct reported five murders, 13 rapes, 235 robberies, 265 felony assaults, 108 burglaries, 609 grand larcenies, and 323 grand larcenies auto in 2022.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www1.nyc.gov/assets/nypd/downloads/pdf/crime_statistics/cs-en-us-045pct.pdf|title=45th Precinct CompStat Report|website=www.nyc.gov|publisher=[[New York City Police Department]]|access-date=May 9, 2021}}</ref>

==Fire safety==
Country Club is served by the [[New York City Fire Department]] (FDNY)'s Engine Co. 89/Ladder Co. 50 is located at 2924 Bruckner Boulevard.<ref>{{cite web | title=Engine Company 89/Ladder Company 50 | website=FDNYtrucks.com | url=http://www.fdnytrucks.com/files/html/bronx/e89.htm | access-date=March 14, 2019}}</ref><ref>{{Cite FDNY locations}}</ref>

==Transportation==
Country Club is close to [[Interstate 95 in New York|Interstate 95]] as well as to major bridges such as the [[Throgs Neck Bridge]]. There are two [[New York City Subway]] stations nearby: [[Pelham Bay Park (IRT Pelham Line)|Pelham Bay Park]] and [[Buhre Avenue (IRT Pelham Line)|Buhre Avenue]], both on the {{NYCS trains|Pelham north}}, are located to the northwest in the [[Pelham Bay (neighborhood), Bronx|Pelham Bay]] neighborhood.<ref>{{NYCS const|map}}</ref> Additionally, the community is the home of the Evers Marina and Seaplane Base on the west bank of [[Eastchester Bay]] at Outlook Point.<ref>[http://www.eversmarina.com/ Evers Marina and Seaplane Base]</ref><ref>[http://www.airnav.com/airport/6N6 Evers Seaplane Base - 6N6 (AirNav.com)]</ref>

The following [[MTA Regional Bus Operations]] bus routes serve Country Club:<ref>{{cite NYC bus map|Bx}}</ref>
* [[Bx8 (New York City bus)|Bx8]]: to [[Locust Point, Bronx|Locust Point]] or [[Williamsbridge]] via Throgs Neck Boulevard, Crosby Avenue, Williamsbridge Road, and Bronxwood Avenue
* [[Bx24 (New York City bus)|Bx24]]: to Hutchinson Metro Center via Marconi Street, Westchester Avenue, Bruckner Boulevard, and Country Club Road
* [[BxM8 (New York City bus)|BxM8]]: to [[Pelham Bay (neighborhood), Bronx|Pelham Bay]] or [[Midtown Manhattan]] via Bruckner Expressway
* [[BxM9 (New York City bus)|BxM9]]: to [[Throggs Neck]] or Midtown Manhattan via Bruckner Expressway
